description: Universal rendering rules for tabletop miniature-style renders - applicable to all character types

generic_render_rules.description: Universal rendering rules applied to all prompts
rules: SINGLE FIGURE ONLY: exactly one character/creature in the entire image. NO other figures, NO background characters, NO companions, NO additional people or animals. Only the main subject.
Framing: FULL FIGURE only -- show entire character fully in frame; do not crop limbs, hands, feet, tail, ears, or held object tips. Centered composition, 3/4 view preferred.
Camera: medium focal length (no wide-angle distortion), eye-level or slightly elevated angle.
Lighting: overhead key light with strong rim light and subtle fill for edge definition. Use directional rim to define depth and emphasize form separation.

Materials: uniform matte light-to-mid grey, unpainted sculpt/maquette look. Monochrome only — no painted colors, no dyed regions, no pure black or pure white. Surfaces have even diffuse response for silhouette and plane readability.

Rendering style (CRITICAL): HIGHLY STYLIZED ILLUSTRATION — graphic silhouettes, simplified planes, posterized value bands. Clean shapes and bold secondary forms; crisp plane breaks. Coarse-to-medium texture scale; avoid fine microtexture, micro-noise, realistic skin pores, strand-level detail. Matte materials; no specular sparkle. Not photoreal.

Texture: bold surface detail as graphic shapes with crisp edges and clean separation. Prioritize form hierarchy: big shapes first, secondary forms next; texture scale stays coarse-to-medium (no ultra-fine noise).
Photographic artifacts: avoid lens effects (flare, bokeh), film grain, subsurface scattering, volumetric glow. Keep illustrative clarity and graphic readability.

Fur/hair rendering (furred creatures only): bold clumps/tufts with deep grooves and clean separation between masses. NO individual hairs, NO micro-fuzz, NO flyaways, NO strand-level detail. Texture as graphic shapes, not noise.

Background/presentation: figure-only presentation. Background absent/blank — no scenery, terrain, props, set dressing, gradient, studio context, or environmental objects. Subject reads in isolation without backdrop.

Item visibility (CRITICAL): any prop/object must be fully visible from base to tip, not crossing or overlapping torso/limbs. Clear negative space between held object and figure. No motion blur, depth-of-field blur, or foreshortening that hides length.
Prop constraint (CRITICAL): do not add props unless explicitly specified. Only include items clearly named and described. Do not invent extra weapons, holsters, or implements.
Action poses: must be illustrative and expressive, readable from single view without limb/object overlap. Held objects presented away from torso with clear negative space.

Value contrast (CRITICAL): depth expressed through greys. Darkest recesses as deep grey (not black); brightest planes as light grey (not pure white). Avoid uniform lighting that flattens forms; emphasize overhead lighting for readable separation.
generic_render_rules.prompt_snippet: HIGHLY STYLIZED, NOT PHOTOREAL — unpainted sculpt look: uniform matte light-to-mid grey; depth by greys (no color); no pure black or pure white. FIGURE-ONLY PRESENTATION: whole figure visible; background absent/blank; clear negative space; no scenery/base/pedestal; no invented props. Camera: centered 3/4, medium focal length, eye-level or slightly elevated; lighting: overhead key with rim separation; graphic silhouettes, posterized value bands, simplified planes, clean plane breaks; coarse-to-medium textures; matte surfaces
